title: [GMCP 203.007.05] Interoperability and quality: Transport adapter SPI and embedded/in-process operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-007-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: A stable transport SPI admits in-process, Unix-domain socket, named-pipe, WebSocket or future transports without changing protocol semantics. A common conformance harness proves ordering, cancellation, limits, identity propagation, observability, shutdown, and error equivalence across adapters, while experimental transports are capability-negotiated and never silently presented as standard MCP. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Core serves the server role only on the byte-pipe transport SPI; the client role, named pipes and WebSocket have no adapter in core and are not claimed.
Budgets are ceilings for an unoptimized test build measured on Linux x86_64; memory growth is measured only where /proc/self/statm exists. Windows x86_64 runs the in-process and stdio adapters only.

reuse.reason: The harness, fixtures and both gates already exist; the test composes them. The one production change removes a fatal branch in establish (a notification or stray response before any lifecycle ended the session) that the modern-era fixture replay found. No new dependency.
reuse.searched: Susi Core: the adapter helpers of gmcp_req_203_007_03_integration and gmcp_req_203_007_04_adversarial (embedded duplex, Unix-domain socket pair, shipped stdio entry point), the interop tests of the sibling vectors (gmcp_req_203_006_05_interop, gmcp_req_203_008_05_interop), the pinned reference fixtures and divergence record under .agents/gmcp/fixtures, crates/susi-gmcp/src/jsonrpc_gate.rs (classify_line, http_envelope_rejection) and crates/susi-gmcp/src/mcp/service.rs (establish).
